music.caption_template: Slow, spacious ambient chamber music featuring {instruments}. Use only these instruments; preserve the guide's timing and melodic contours. Instrumental, no vocals.

models.label: ACE-Step Base
models.description: Full composition with 50 steps and guidance controls, using the earlier ambient style prompt. Takes longer, especially on CPU. Recommended when you want a fuller musical interpretation; other model versions are kept.

models.label: Stable Audio 3 Small Music
models.description: A smaller, fast eight-step model using a prompt focused on the selected guide instruments. Its musical interpretation and audio transformation controls differ from ACE-Step.

models.label: ACE-Step Turbo
models.description: Fast eight-step preview using the earlier ambient style prompt. Instruments and musical detail can differ from Base. Saved separately so you can compare the two.
